verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is first-party documented as automating sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance on all transactions, with a no-code guide to calculating and collecting tax on payment pages, and tax calculations appear in the API surface. The evidence is only short landing-page claims, though. Missing for 10: detail on jurisdiction coverage and rate accuracy, how tax applies across Checkout/Billing/Invoicing beyond Payment Links, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the calculated tax is correct.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can calculate and collect the correct sales tax, VAT, or GST on every transaction automatically

citations.quote: Automate sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance on all your transactions.
Collect tax on Payment Links: Learn how to calculate and collect tax on a payment page without writing any code.
